fact: The World Bank ICR states Djibouti's Social Registry, built under the earlier PITCH project, was used to target the emergency transfers of project P178992, with 98 percent of target beneficiary households included in the registry at closing in September 2025, while interoperability gaps between the registry and payment systems materialized and full interoperability with other administrative databases remains to be resourced.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report, Social Protection Emergency Crisis Response Project (P178992)
